name: When should I retain a federal criminal attorney?

mainEntity.name: When should I retain a federal criminal attorney?

acceptedAnswer.text: Retain a federal criminal attorney as soon as you become aware of a federal investigation or receive contact from federal agents to ensure your rights are protected and mistakes are avoided from the outset.heathhydelawyer​
